title: brief.made@1
description: Where a brief from your own words is (#1342): asked, refused, or made into a project whose tasks run under the card's ask. Only the core appends it.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

step.description: Where the brief is: asked from your words; refused, naming why; made, its home; entered, a task; applied, the run started under the card's ask; held, a due step raised on a card of its own; repeated, a job that repeats entered its tasks again.

x-closure.closed: a brief is asked, refused or applied, and an applied one's home, tasks, held steps and rounds are recorded
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

key.description: The brief's key: the SHA-256 of your words and your files.

heading.description: Its heading, from your first words.

words.description: Your words, as you typed them.

links.description: The links your words hold, each as you gave it.

files.description: The files you attached, each by its path as you gave it.

reason.description: Why it was refused, naming what refused it.

project.description: Its home: a workspace's id, or a repo's owner and name.

folder.description: Its home's folder on this machine.

repo.description: The private repo made for software, as owner/name.

clone.description: The new repo's address for git.

there.description: True when you answered with a project of yours instead of a new one.

number.description: The task's number in its home.

index.description: The held step's place on the brief, from 0.

ask.description: The ask raised for the held step.

round.description: Which round of a job that repeats.
